title: Fragment cost trellis: export & orchestration UX for token-level pricing insights
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a new 'Fragment Trellis' view in Redwood Console that lets customers slice token-level cost by multiple dimensions (model variant, route, prompt template, workspace, and time window) and export curated fragments to CSV/Parquet with SKU mappings. This ticket covers UX, interaction patterns for pricing previews (slab/step/volume discounts), an orchestration modal for scheduled exports, and a lightweight reconciliation preview so finance teams can validate exported rows against billing line-items.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive trellis prototype that supports at least 3 simultaneous dimensions (e.g., model x route x time) and toggles between absolute/normalized cost
Export wizard flows for one-off CSV export and scheduled Parquet delivery to S3/GCS with field-mapping UI to billing SKU and customer tags
Pricing preview panel that shows per-fragment unit cost, projected monthly spend, and how slab pricing changes affect totals
Usability test results from 5 sessions with engineers/product-finance showing no more than 2 usability issues each

Design handoff artifacts (Figma frames, tokens, component spec) and an engineering summary documenting required backend fields (fragment_id, model_hash, route_id, prompt_template_id, token_count, kv_cache_hit_rate, cost_usd, billing_sku)
Accessibility review completed: color contrast & keyboard flows validated for trellis navigation and export modal
comments: 2026-02-11 - Aisha Patel: Initial kickoff: sketched grid-first approach. Decided to call it 'Fragment Trellis' to emphasize multi-dimensional slicing rather than a flat table. Linking initial whiteboard sketches in attachments below.

2026-02-18 - Claire Yeo (PM): Reviewed prototype; requested a reconciliation preview that shows how exported rows map to billing line-items (important for enterprise finance teams). Added 'billing_sku' to required fields.

2026-02-24 - Miguel Santos (Design): Iteration 2 uploaded to Figma (see attachments). Introduced mini-sparklines per-fragment and inline cost deltas for slab pricing. Need eng input on cost calculation latency for preview when users flip slab parameters.

2026-02-26 - Jonas Becker (Eng): Backend note: real-time slab preview will need a cached pricing table and aggregation endpoint; otherwise previews slow for large slices. Suggested adding 'preview cap' and incremental approximation for >100k fragments.

2026-03-01 - UX Research: Ran 5 moderated sessions with internal PMs and one external beta customer. Insights: users want a simple 'export template' save flow and clear sample-row preview. Observed confusion around normalization options (per-token vs per-request). Updated flows to emphasize unit selection up front.

2026-03-04 - Security Review (Tim Li): Export to S3/GCS design must include optional KMS key selector and explicit retention policy field. Marked ticket for security_review_required = true for Private deployments.
